dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (The notes are full of words scribbled messily by hand. Even the few blank spaces are filled with twisted charts. Any reader would sense that the writer's chain of thoughts is chaotic.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...I'm stuck. I may have found many signs... but theories cannot be proved by mere signs..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Besides, the aura of the Raiden Shogun and the Serpent's remains is too strong, covering the traces that might belong to Umibouzu..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...The tales of monsters that I've collected in Inazuma before... have not been proven yet..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...This is such a headache. In getting the necessary documents from the Kanjou Commission, I've spent my entire budget. I'll be in trouble if there is still no progress..."
